name: paperlesspaper OpenPaper L
description: 13.3 inch 6-colour Spectra 6 ePaper picture frame from paperlesspaper (Germany): ESP32-C6 (4 MB flash, no PSRAM), 4 x AA NiMH cells, CP2102N USB-C serial. 1200x1600 portrait-native E Ink EL133UF3 panel on two controllers. Speaks Tesserae's v1 REST device API; the esp32_bin renderer packs the same 4-bpp 960000-byte frame as the Waveshare 13.3E6, which the firmware streams into the panel controllers in row blocks because it cannot hold the frame in RAM. Pair with the tesserae-device-firmware ESP-IDF build (env paperlesspaper-openpaper-l, boards/paperlesspaper_openpaper_l.h).
notes_md: Not yet confirmed on real hardware: the firmware target was written from the vendor's open firmware without an L on the bench, so it ships as an experimental build. Same flash-backup caveat as the OpenPaper 7 (the vendor cloud certificate lives in a SPIFFS region the Tesserae layout overwrites). Frames are the Waveshare 13.3E6 layout: 1600 rows of 600 packed bytes, left half first. Features that need a frame in device RAM (always-on mode, the cloud relay, the SD deck cache) are not available on this board.
